arguments.sql_query:
SELECT YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS prescriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 21603890
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= '2019-01-01'
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date)
ORDER BY year

WITH years AS (
  SELECT 2019 AS yr, CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE) AS end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2020, CAST('2020-01-01' AS DATE), CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE)
), denominators AS (
  SELECT y.yr, COUNT(DISTINCT op.person_id) AS active_patients
  FROM years y
  JOIN omop.observation_period op
    ON op.observation_period_start_date < y.end_date
   AND op.observation_period_end_date >= y.start_date
  GROUP BY y.yr
), immunosuppressant_rx AS (
  SELECT YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS yr,
         COUNT(*) AS prescriptions,
         COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS treated_patients
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 21603890
    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= '2019-01-01'
    AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < '2021-01-01'
  GROUP BY YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date)
)
SELECT d.yr AS year,
       d.active_patients,
       COALESCE(r.prescriptions,0) AS prescriptions,
       COALESCE(r.treated_patients,0) AS treated_patients,
       CAST(1000.0 * COALESCE(r.prescriptions,0) / d.active_patients AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS prescriptions_per_1000_active_patients,
       CAST(1000.0 * COALESCE(r.treated_patients,0) / d.active_patients AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS treated_patients_per_1000_active_patients
FROM denominators d
LEFT JOIN immunosuppressant_rx r ON r.yr = d.yr
ORDER BY d.yr

content.text:
No — in this OMOP dataset, systemic immunosuppressant prescription rates increased in 2020 compared with 2019.

Using ATC ancestor concept `21603890` = `IMMUNOSUPPRESSANTS` over `drug_exposure`:

| Year | Prescriptions | Treated patients | Active patients | Rx / 1,000 active patients |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2019 | 243,677 | 12,602 | 4,052,984 | 60.12 |
| 2020 | 272,184 | 13,627 | 4,240,236 | 64.19 |

That is an increase of about **6.8%** in prescription rate per active patient, not a decline.
